newsitem.title: USA: Yahoo!, MTV launch Web music guide.
newsitem.headline: Yahoo!, MTV launch Web music guide.

text.p: Yahoo! Inc said it and Viacom Inc.'s MTV Networks would on Wednesday launch MTV/Yahoo! unfURLed, a guide to music on the World Wide Web.

The site, at (http://www.unfurled.com), will be updated several times daily as a one-stop shop for music information on the Web, including reviews of hundreds of music sites and entertainment listings.
The unfURLed site contains an A to Z artists directory of more than 1,100 performers and bands that offers users links to sites about their favorite musicians.

The site will be advertising-sponsored and distributed on the respective sites of Yahoo! (http://www.yahoo.com), MTV Online (http://mtv.com) and Netscape Guide by Yahoo! (http://netscape.yahoo.com/guide).

It will include five main categories - Smarty Rants for music journalism, Encyclomedia for rich content music sites, Gossip Gossip, Gossip for the latest buzz on artists and music, Totally Whack for fun music sites and Riffs Online for sites with sound and cybercasts.
